verdict.rationale: Wise Business exposes a full REST API (transfers, batch groups, webhooks, multi-currency accounts, statements) that can be scripted and called headlessly outside any UI, which is the core requirement for CI/automation use. However there is no explicit CLI, SDK, or CI/pipeline example, no OpenAPI spec discoverable (openapi probe 404s), and no mention of service-account/token patterns tailored for automated pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples or SDKs, discoverable OpenAPI spec, documented non-interactive auth flow for pipelines.
